nodes.label: Module 14 — Interdisciplinary Group (IDG)
nodes.rationale: The operational heart of hospice clinical governance; M14's lock is the enabler that flips M7/M11/M12's already-shipped fixture-tested consumers to live production wiring.

nodes.label: IDG Meeting Lifecycle with Adjournment as Commit Point
nodes.rationale: On adjournment all in-progress decisions emit to the outbox, action items lock assignees and due dates, minutes flip to final and packet rows freeze — one atomic commit point makes the survey artifact deterministic.

nodes.label: IDG_REQUIRED_QUORUM Evaluated Per-Decision (D3)
nodes.rationale: Evaluating quorum per-decision rather than per-meeting lets a meeting proceed while a member is briefly absent (the discussion happens) while still blocking the recording of decisions during that gap. A meeting-level check at start time falsely allows decisions recorded after a member leaves, and a coordinator-waivable quorum opens the survey-citation barn door.

nodes.label: idg_patient_packet — derived, frozen on adjournment (D1, D5, D7)
nodes.rationale: Clinicians get a fresh editable artifact pre-meeting and surveyors get a deterministic frozen snapshot after; per-patient idempotency on (meeting_id, patient_id) keeps retries safe under outbox redelivery. Discipline views are derived at build time into one row so the packet stays a single artifact to render and freeze — computing views on read would defeat both the survey artifact and the offline-mobile path.

nodes.label: Canonical idg.decision_recorded Outbox Event (D4, 9-kind discriminated union)
nodes.rationale: A single payload prevents shape drift across the four downstream consumers already locked against it, and the exhaustive union compels coordinated multi-module change for new kinds — exactly the friction wanted at the spec boundary. Per-kind topics would fragment consumers and defeat M11's one-consumer pattern; free-form jsonb would defeat compile-time exhaustiveness at consumer call sites.

nodes.label: Action-Item Carry-Forward + Auto-Close Engine (D8)
nodes.rationale: Auto-close on a downstream artifact reaching an absorbing state prevents the 'MSW closed the loop but forgot to mark the item done' failure mode; three consecutive carry-forwards raise a critical Compliance alert because repeatedly-deferred follow-up is an OIG survey marker. The threshold is deliberately not tenant-configurable so it cannot be loosened to mask the issue.

nodes.label: idg_minutes Immutable on final + Amendment Row (D10)
nodes.rationale: Schema-level enforcement of the CoP 418.104 accurate-clinical-record invariant for the artifact surveyors most often inspect; full immutability with no amendment path is clinically untenable because misattributions and typos happen, so the M5 §164.526 amendment row makes corrections discoverable without enabling silent edits.

nodes.label: Per-Patient (Per-POC) 15-Day Review Floor (D17 / M14-F01)
nodes.rationale: The location-wide cadence is escapable by cancel/reschedule and is per-location, not per-POC; surveyors cite the missed review of a patient's plan of care, so the authoritative control is last_idg_reviewed_at + 15 days per included patient. CANCEL and RESCHEDULE are guarded and refused unless a covering meeting exists or an audited step-up override is recorded, and a missed review escalates rather than silently lapsing.

nodes.label: Notification Composition Moved to M36 (ADR-0024 supersedes D14–D16)
nodes.rationale: M14's v0.3 secondary role as the cross-module notification-composition layer (with its own notification_template tables) was superseded: recipient resolution and dispatch belong to M36. M14 now only emits typed alert payloads validated against M36's alert_payload_catalog and never writes to channels directly.

nodes.label: 5-Minute Step-Up Auth on Adjournment (D13)
nodes.rationale: Adjournment is a multi-row mutating commit (decisions emit, minutes finalize, packets freeze), so the actor's identity must be fresh-verified at that moment; an unattended session at meeting end is the realistic threat. Step-up on every decision would over-burden the meeting flow where quorum plus permission already suffice.
